thesis: A high-beta (1.808), 27.66% short-float stock is being bought into a risk-off tape (QQQ below 50/200-day, VIX at the 0.858 percentile, tech leading the decline) after the post-earnings move is already priced in. The price is 9% above its SMA20 and 2.8% below a 52-week high that has not been broken on volume: the 11/18 bounce came on 0.84x volume and the card itself says it is not a confirmed breakout. Valuation is rich (trailing P/E 98.7, P/S 11.1, EV/EBITDA 49.3), the mean analyst target of 69.43 is only about 5% above the close, and revenue growth is decelerating from about 70% to 60.7% YoY. Reward/risk of 1.9 is thin for a name with a 4.7% ATR, and a stop at 61.2 sits only about 1.3 ATR from entry, so ordinary noise or a market flush can hit it. Debt of 754.4M against cash of 504.7M leaves a convertible or equity raise after the rally possible, and there is no scheduled catalyst to carry the stock.
